description: A local-first strategy consulting plugin that interrogates business, marketing, positioning, go-to-market, sales, and validation plans, then turns decisions into live working documents.

defaultPrompt: Interrogate this business idea and find its weakest assumption.
Challenge this go-to-market plan one question at a time.
Turn these strategy notes into risks, decisions, and experiments.
interface.longDescription: Consultor challenges business ideas, marketing plans, positioning, pricing, go-to-market, sales, and validation. It asks one focused question at a time, exposes assumptions and contradictions, and turns decisions into living documents such as SWOT/DAFO, business model canvas, positioning, experiment plans, and final reports.

name: consultor
